name: geo-visibility-monitor
title: GEO / AEO Visibility Monitor
description: Monitor brand visibility, citations, competitors, and changes across AI search and web search results.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Brand to monitor. Use name, aliases, and owned domains.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Questions to ask search and AI search engines.
default: best project management software for small teams

markets.title: Markets
markets.description: Market objects with countryCode, languageCode, and optional location.

engines.title: Source Actors
engines.description: Apify source Actors to run. The default uses Apify Google Search Results Scraper.

sourceActorInput.title: Source Actor options
sourceActorInput.description: Optional source Actor fields. For Google Search, use aiOverview, aiModeSearch, perplexitySearch, chatGptSearch, copilotSearch, or geminiSearch to enable AEO/GEO data.

maxQueries.title: Maximum queries
maxQueries.description: Hard limit protecting the run from accidental cost growth.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Maximum results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of search result records to use for each query.

maxTotalChargeUsd.title: Maximum source Actor charge
maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Optional cap for EACH source run, further limited by the remaining aggregate source budget. Does not include this monitor's own compute/storage charges.

maxSourceBudgetUsd.title: Total source budget (USD)
maxSourceBudgetUsd.description: Aggregate budget across source runs in this monitor run. Unknown charges consume their full reserved allowance. Monitor compute/storage charges are additional. Zero disables new source runs.

maxSourceRuns.title: Maximum source runs
maxSourceRuns.description: Maximum source launch attempts across all queries, markets, and engines. Zero disables new launches.

sourceTimeoutSeconds.title: Source timeout (seconds)
sourceTimeoutSeconds.description: Platform timeout for each source run. Shortened when the monitor approaches its own timeout; active sources are aborted on local timeout when possible.

monitorId.title: Monitor project ID
monitorId.description: Stable project identifier, for example notion-us. Use the same value on recurring runs to compare history. Different projects remain isolated.

historyEnabled.title: Enable persistent history
historyEnabled.description: Create or reuse a named history store in your Apify account. Compare compatible observations from earlier completed runs. Requires normal storage creation permissions.

historyRetentionDays.title: History retention (days)
historyRetentionDays.description: Delete this monitor project's older history records when it next runs. Named stores persist until explicitly cleaned or deleted.

historyKey.title: History key
historyKey.description: History namespace, combined with monitorId. Kept for input compatibility; old run-local history arrays are not imported because their configuration cannot be verified.

includeRawSource.title: Include raw source data
includeRawSource.description: Include the source record in each output item. This increases dataset size.
